label: WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE
head: Every bad day becomes a 20-min rant
sub: Your team, your partner, your group chat. All carrying your weight.

head: Know the difference
l: Same rant every night, no plan
r: Names it once, asks for real help

items.head: Write it down
items.sub: Half of it shrinks once it's on paper.

items.head: Name one next step
items.sub: Something you can do before tomorrow.

label: THEN
head: Talk to someone who's solved it
sub: A mentor or a friend who's been there, not whoever is closest.

text: Pressure isn't losing. It's *the price of growing.*

head: Less venting, *more solving*
sub: Send this to the friend who always hears it first.
